'''TD-10036-EM-1271''' was a star in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It was [[Destruction of TD-10036-EM-1271|destroyed]] by the [[Sacorrian Triad]] using [[Centerpoint Station]], though [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]] claimed credit as a power play.
